relations.subject: Arthur Emanuel Christensen
relations.evidence: He studied under the famous Iranologist F. C. Andreas, and, in 1903, he obtained his Ph.D.

relations.subject: Arthur Emanuel Christensen
relations.evidence: In 1919, he was appointed professor extraordinarius of Iranian philology at the University of Copenhagen, an office that he held for the rest of his life.

relations.subject: Arthur Emanuel Christensen
relations.evidence: Christensen encountered the works of folklorists such as Axel Olrik and C. W. von Sydow, which led him into studies of general folklore, folk psychology, and philosophy.
